settings.delete.title: Delete my account
settings.delete.consequenceWindow: The request opens a 30-day recovery window. You can restore the account from the restore screen while it is open.
settings.delete.consequenceErase: After the window, your account and its data are permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete.consequenceRestore: Signing in during the window does not restore the account; only the Restore action does.
settings.delete.retained: Some records may be kept after your account is deleted where the law requires it. The exact list appears here once your deletion begins.
settings.delete.confirmBody: This opens a 30-day recovery window. After it closes, the account and its data are permanently erased and cannot be recovered.
settings.restore.banner: Your account and its data will be erased on {date} unless you restore the account before then.
settings.restore.closed: The recovery window closed on {date}; the account can no longer be restored.
settings.restore.noRequest: There is no open deletion request for this account.
